text.リビング前に広がる緑を最大限に取り込んだ開放感のあるマンションリフォーム。クロー: An open apartment renovation that takes in as much as possible of the greenery in front of the living room. The previously closed kitchen was opened up and fitted with an all-stainless-steel kitchen made to order. With lime plaster walls and solid teak flooring, the attention stays on the materials, and the result is a bright, open, settled and finely made space.
text.5ミリの厚さのステンレス無垢材を天板にした存在感のあるキッチン。: A kitchen with presence, its worktop a solid 5 mm stainless steel.
text.バックセットの収納はチークの厚突きの扉とし、木の質感を大切にしました。内部はそれ: The back run is fronted in thick teak veneer, keeping the feel of the timber. Inside, each cupboard has drawers fitted to what it holds: a kitchen made to order down to the detail.
text.防火性・調湿性・安全性に優れた、接着剤を含まない100％自然素材の漆喰を使用。熟: A 100% natural lime plaster containing no adhesive, excellent for fire resistance, humidity regulation and safety. Laid by a skilled plasterer, smooth and full of character. The texture of the plaster wall makes a room in which the paintings and screens that furnish the home are shown at their best.
text.リビングの窓に設置したウッドシャッターは、光の入り方を調整するだけでなく、視線を: The wooden shutters at the living-room windows control how the light enters, and let the air from outside in freely while keeping the room from being overlooked.
